title: identity_params
description: GA4 client and session identity parameters. Composed only on auto-collected session boundary events.

client_id.description: GA4 client identifier from the _ga cookie.

ga_session_number.description: Ordinal number of the session for this client.

ignore_referrer.description: Instructs GA4 to ignore the referrer for attribution.

traffic_type.description: Traffic segment label, e.g. for internal traffic filtering.
